top_signals.title: Diesel squeeze set to last well into 2027 as Iran war disrupts supply, IEA says
top_signals.summary: Diesel supply is expected to remain tight into 2027 as Iran war-related disruption, falling inventories and resilient demand strain the market, the IEA said.
